content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The current payment infrastructure in Ghana and other African countries is plagued by restrictions and limitations. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal have blocked access for many digital creators, making it difficult to sell digital products online. But there's a solution: a sovereign digital commerce stack that gives you full control over your transactions and infrastructure. By leveraging Cloudflare infrastructure, blockchain payments, and open-source tools, you can bypass these restrictions and get paid online without relying on third-party platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need a few key components. First, you'll need a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your online store. Next, you'll need a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script account for handling backend logic and payment processing. You'll also need a Supabase or Google Sheets account for storing orders and customer information. And finally, you'll need a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for delivering digital products to customers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a crucial step in deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack. You'll need to integrate your payment gateway, NOWPayments, with your online store and backend logic. This will enable automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and instant delivery of digital products to customers. You can choose from a range of cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
You have full control over your transactions and infrastructure with a sovereign digital commerce stack.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Going live with your sovereign digital commerce stack is an exciting milestone, but it requires careful planning and execution. You'll need to test your payment and delivery pipeline thoroughly to ensure that everything is working as expected. Once you've completed your testing, you can start processing transactions and delivering digital products to customers. Remember to monitor your transactions closely and adjust your infrastructure as needed to optimize performance and security.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your sovereign digital commerce stack is up and running, you'll need to scale it to meet growing demand. This involves adding more infrastructure components, such as load balancers and caching layers, to ensure that your online store can handle increased traffic without experiencing downtime or performance issues. You can also use tools like Binance P2P to support multiple currencies, including naira, cedis, and Kenyan shillings.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: create a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your online store; set up a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script account for handling backend logic and payment processing; integrate NOWPayments with your online store and backend logic for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification; set up a Supabase or Google Sheets account for storing orders and customer information; and finally, set up a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for delivering digital products to customers. Don't forget to test your payment and delivery pipeline thoroughly before going live.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I choose the right cryptocurrency for my online store?

When choosing a cryptocurrency for your online store, consider factors such as transaction speed, fees, and security. USDT on Tron, for example, settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, making it a popular choice for online transactions. You can also consider other cryptocurrencies like Binance Coin or Solana.
Can I use my existing payment gateway with NOWPayments?

Yes, you can integrate your existing payment gateway with NOWPayments. This will enable automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and instant delivery of digital products to customers. Simply follow the integration instructions provided by NOWPayments to set up your payment gateway.
How do I store orders and customer information?

You can store orders and customer information in a Supabase or Google Sheets account. This will enable you to manage customer data and orders effectively, and also provide you with a record of all transactions.
Can I deliver digital products to customers in multiple currencies?

Yes, you can deliver digital products to customers in multiple currencies using Binance P2P. This will enable you to support customers from different countries and regions, and also provide you with more flexibility in terms of currency support.
